lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five semi-parallel horizontal rows along the lateral flank, with a higher density of nodes concentrated in the mid-body region posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like matrix of anchor nodes, most clearly defined on the lateral flank between the pectoral and first dorsal fins.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light to dark, extending from the posterior head region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 8-12 high-luminance blobs is localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the ventral and posterior regions of the fin surface.
